title: 12 Best Craft Beer Bars in Oslo — The Reddit-Backed Guide
description: The best craft beer bars in Oslo, Norway — curated from Reddit reviews. RØØR, Crow Bar, Brygg, Schouskjelleren & more. Tap lists, brewery tours, and honest verdicts.

places.name: RØØR
places.verdict: Oslo's undisputed craft beer throne — 64 taps of rotating craft beer from Norway and beyond, with some of the most knowledgeable staff in the city.

places.name: Crow Bar & Brewery
places.verdict: Oslo's veteran craft beer bar and brewery — they brew their own beer in-house plus pour 20+ guest taps. A Torggata institution.

places.name: Brygg Oslo
places.verdict: The biggest selection in Oslo — around 150 beers available on tap, can, and bottle. A beer nerd's paradise.

places.name: Grünerløkka Brygghus
places.verdict: Neighborhood brewpub in the heart of trendy Grünerløkka — brews their own beer and captures the local vibe perfectly.

places.name: Schouskjelleren Mikrobryggeri
places.verdict: Oslo's highest-rated craft beer spot (4.7★) — a microbrewery in the cellars of the former Schou Brewery, which was Oslo's oldest brewery when it closed in 1981.

places.name: Oslo Mikrobryggeri
places.verdict: One of Oslo's original microbreweries — established on upscale Bogstadveien, brewing since the 1990s. A city institution.

places.name: Amundsen Bryggeri & Spiseri
places.verdict: Amundsen is one of Norway's most respected craft breweries — and their city center brewpub serves the full range alongside a solid food menu.

places.name: Territoriet
places.verdict: A Grünerløkka gem that straddles the line between natural wine bar and craft beer destination — excellent curated selection of both.

places.name: Nedre Foss Gård
places.verdict: A riverside beer garden by the Akerselva waterfall — one of Oslo's most beautiful spots to drink craft beer in summer.

places.name: Hopyard
places.verdict: A craft beer specialist inside Mathallen — Oslo's premier food hall. Combine world-class food shopping with excellent Norwegian craft beer.

places.name: Håndslag
places.verdict: A no-frills craft beer bar popular with locals — less tourist-heavy than the big names but with a loyal following.

places.name: Den Glade Gris
places.verdict: Oslo's most-reviewed restaurant with 5,100+ reviews and a 4.6 rating — excellent craft beer selection alongside outstanding food.
